messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall - sustained high GPU queueing for enterprise pool 'sapphire-enterprise' (tenant: Sapphire Health). Metrics: GPU util >95%, queue length ~320, 503 rate spike. Alert window started 14:02 UTC.
oncall_jamie: I'm on it. doing quick triage now.
sre_raj: seeing a sustained flood from sapphire-prod - ~12k reqs/min. KV cache thrash on long conversations.
infra_sasha: running quick status: `rcli pool status --pool sapphire-enterprise` -> no spare nodes, autoscale flagged OFF for this tenant (explicit config).
jamie: cs_emma - any direct report from the customer? severity?
cs_emma: CS oncall: Sapphire Health reported increased latency and intermittent 503s starting ~14:02. They're running a promotional campaign hitting prod. Impacting critical endpoints.
jamie: ok. mitigation candidates: 1) request burst override to add GPUs 2) route part of traffic to hosted fallback models 3) temporarily switch tenant to lower-memory/quantized variant 4) soft-rate-limit tenant. Need fastest-low-risk path.
pm_leo: Hosted fallback has auth gating but is lowest-ops path if we can warm it. Burst is fastest if capacity-ops approves.
raj: I'll open burst approval. command: `/approve-burst-request --tenant sapphire-enterprise --requested 4gpus --reason "promo flood causing 503s"`
incident-bot: Approval request BRST-5421 created (link: https://redwood.ops/approvals/BRST-5421).
infra_sasha: while approval pending, I'll apply a soft rate limit at tenant level to 200rps to ease queueing.
jamie: please do it and start warmup for hosted fallback model (quantized embedding + smaller LLM) so we can canary cutover.
infra_sasha: rate limiter applied :white_check_mark: queue dropping to ~120. Starting hosted fallback warmup (pulling model into pool).
raj: pinging capacity-ops for BRST-5421 approval @ops_capacity.
ops_capacity: BRST-5421 evaluated. Capacity available for +2 GPUs immediately; +4 needs further procurement. Approving +2 for 60min window.
jamie: ok spin +2 GPUs now, start canary routing 10% to hosted fallback, monitor error rate and latency.
infra_sasha: `rcli pool add-nodes --pool sapphire-enterprise --count 2 --flavor a100` -> job 9832 started.
jamie: canary started (10% -> hosted fallback). Initial telemetry: errors down ~45%, p95 latency down ~30%.
cs_emma: customer notified: "We're activating a short-term burst and fallback route to reduce errors. Expect reduced disruptions; will follow up in 15m."
pm_leo: good call on warmup. keep monitoring token queue depth and KV hit rate.
raj: taking monitoring handoff from jamie for the next 30m. If queue >100 after 20m, escalate for an additional +2 GPUs or increase hosted fallback to 30%.
jamie: handing off fully to raj. I'll update incident doc and sleep on standby. :thumbsup:
raj: acknowledged, continuing watch. ops_capacity has contact on standby if we need to extend burst.
cs_emma: logging customer update in support ticket and scheduling a post-mortem with Sapphire Health for tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident thread updated: BRST-5421 status CHANGED -> PARTIAL_APPROVED (2 GPUs). metrics link: https://redwood.monitor/sapphire-enterprise/graphs
raj: closing this thread for active mitigation handoff — will post resolution summary once we scale down and validate stability.
